test_goal: Evaluate whether an automation agent converts an approved server-to-application-pool membership event into least-privilege, idempotent Illumio and firewall policy; repairs partial state; and safely blocks, defers, or escalates invalid and conflicting requests.
dataset_context: Use one fictional enterprise. Each record is a self-contained test case. A server is added to an application pool, whose approved_connectivity_intents are the sole source of allowed flows. The agent may only provision exact protocol/port combinations from active approved intents. It must inspect existing_state, avoid duplicates using canonical rule equivalence and idempotency_key, and never override an explicit deny. Illumio rules use application/environment/role/location labels; firewall rules use server IPs or managed address groups and named zones. For CREATE_BOTH, treat the change as one transaction and report both platform actions. Fields beginning with _expected_ are hidden ground truth and must be mutually consistent with visible inputs.
scenario_guidance: Generate about 40% valid CREATE_BOTH cases, 15% already-provisioned NO_CHANGE cases, 15% partial-state repair cases, 15% BLOCK cases for missing or unauthorized data, 10% DEFER cases for recoverable dependencies, and 5% MANUAL_REVIEW cases for conflicts such as explicit denies. Include single-flow and multi-flow applications, inbound and outbound intent, production and non-production, duplicate events, disabled intents, missing IPs, offline VENs, and firewall conflicts. Never include real hosts, addresses, credentials, or customer names. Use RFC 5737 documentation IP ranges.

field_definitions.name: case_id
field_definitions.description: Unique test case ID such as ARP-001.

field_definitions.name: _test_scenario
field_definitions.description: One of happy_path, idempotent, partial_state, invalid_input, dependency_failure, conflict, or multi_flow.

field_definitions.name: membership_event
field_definitions.description: Trigger with event_id, event_type=SERVER_ADDED_TO_POOL, server_id, pool_id, occurred_at, approved_change_id, and idempotency_key.

field_definitions.name: server
field_definitions.description: CMDB facts: server_id, hostname, ip_address or null, environment, location, network_zone, owner, illumio_workload_id, ven_state, and cmdb_status.

field_definitions.name: application_pool
field_definitions.description: Pool facts: pool_id, application, environment, role, owner, lifecycle_state, security_tier, and Illumio labels.

field_definitions.name: approved_connectivity_intents
field_definitions.description: Approved desired flows with intent_id, status, direction, source, destination, protocol, port, source_zone, destination_zone, and business_purpose.

field_definitions.name: existing_state
field_definitions.description: Existing illumio_rules and firewall_rules relevant to this event, including explicit denies and equivalent rules.

field_definitions.name: _expected_decision
field_definitions.description: One of CREATE_BOTH, CREATE_ILLUMIO_ONLY, CREATE_FIREWALL_ONLY, NO_CHANGE, BLOCK, DEFER, or MANUAL_REVIEW.

field_definitions.name: _expected_actions
field_definitions.description: Ordered platform actions expected from the automation.

field_definitions.name: _expected_illumio_rules
field_definitions.description: Exact normalized Illumio allow rules to create; empty if none.

field_definitions.name: _expected_firewall_rules
field_definitions.description: Exact normalized firewall allow rules to create; empty if none.

field_definitions.name: _expected_reason_code
field_definitions.description: Stable categorical reason explaining the decision.
